It declares constants such as the trusted height, trusting period, clock drift assumptions, whether the primary and secondary are correct, and a faulty ratio, and it declares state variables used by the detector and blockchain model. The file itself contains no top-level Init, Next, Spec, temporal properties, or proofs; instead, it instantiates another module and appears to serve as a parameterized model shell for a faulty-validator scenario.
